name: Forecast
description: Revenue forecast per month from open deals, with the organization method, categories and horizon

page.title: Revenue forecast
page.description: Monthly estimate based on the amount, probability and expected close date of the open deals.
page.stageFallback: Since the deal probability is not visible to you, the stage probability was used.
page.currencyNote: Amounts added up in {{currency}}, without currency conversion.

methodHints.stage_probability: Amount × probability of the stage the deal is in.
methodHints.deal_probability: Amount × probability set on the deal (or of the stage, when empty).
methodHints.commit_only: Adds up only the amount of the deals in the commit category.

chart.title: Forecast per month
chart.label: Bar chart with the open amount, the forecast and the amount won per month

deals.title: Deals of {{month}}
deals.description: Open deals expected to close in the month, largest first.

states.emptyDescription: Open deals expected to close in the next months show up here.
states.hiddenDescription: Your role cannot see the amount or the expected close date of deals.
states.noAccessDescription: Ask an administrator for permission to see deals.

settings.title: Forecast settings
settings.description: Choose how the revenue forecast is calculated for the whole organization.
settings.categoriesHint: Categories come from the probability used in the calculation. The "commit only" method always uses them.
settings.horizonHint: From the current month, in the organization timezone.

errors.percentage: Enter a whole number between 1 and 100.
errors.order: Commit must start above best case.
errors.conflict: The settings were changed by someone else. Reload the page.

settings.methodDescription: How the forecast amount of each open deal is calculated.
settings.categoriesDescription: Split the forecast into confidence ranges based on probability.
